# UET GPT

> UET GPT is an open-source AI chatbot and educational guide to the University of Engineering and Technology (UET), Taxila campus, Pakistan. It answers questions about UET Taxila using RAG-powered retrieval from official university documents, prospectuses, fee schedules, syllabi, and directories.

Last updated: 2026-09-02

Content is continuously updated as UET Taxila publishes new admissions notices, fee updates, and academic schedules.

## What is UET GPT?

- Open-source AI chatbot for UET Taxila students, faculty, and prospective applicants
- Free to use at https://uet-gpt.vercel.app
- Grounded in official UET Taxila data with verified citations, not hallucinations

## Key University Facts

- What does UET stand for?: University of Engineering and Technology
- Admissions Merit Formula: 33% ECAT + 50% HSSC + 17% SSC (+20 marks for Hifz-e-Quran / NCC)
- Minimum Eligibility: 60% in F.Sc (Pre-Engineering) for engineering; 50% for BS Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics
- Faculties: 6 (Civil & Environmental, Electrical & Electronics, Mechanical & Aeronautical, Telecommunication & Information, Industrial, Basic Sciences)
- Total Academic Departments: 14

## What UET GPT Does Not Do

- Does not issue official UET Taxila admissions decisions or offer letters
- Does not replace official university administrative channels (`web.uettaxila.edu.pk`)
- Does not collect payment or charge fees

## Technology

- Frontend: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
- Backend: Convex (real-time reactive database and serverless functions)
- Authentication: Clerk
- AI Models: Llama 4 Scout (Groq), Llama 3.1 8B (Groq)
- Vector Indexing & Embeddings: Convex vector search with Gemini embedding-2
- Hosting: Vercel (Edge network)
